messages:
Sanjay R.: Heads up — Legal from ZephyrBank needs clarifications for the enterprise SQ. Main asks: KMS key residency (must be EU only), BYOK support, RBAC mapping via customer's SAML groups, audit log retention 5y, SIEM push to Splunk, and signed key custody statement. Anyone own the BYOK playbook? /cc @Lauren (Legal)
Lauren (Legal): thanks — can we confirm whether model KV cache or transient tokens ever leave EU? They asked explicitly about prompt caching.
Amy - SecEng: short answer: all persistent storage for that tenant (model cache, logs, embeddings) can be pinned to eu-west-1 in Private/Dedicated. Hosted API currently has a eu region; we need to confirm model artifacts residency. I'll check config.
Matt - Infra: FYI we support BYOK via envelope keys with HSM in the region. Workflow: customer imports RSA/ECC key material into HSM; we create a wrapping key locally and never export cust keys. Evidence we can produce: KMS import logs, HSM attestation report, and key policy snapshot.
Amy - SecEng: For RBAC we map SAML group -> service-role. Example mapping snippet:
```yaml
saml_mapping:
  - group: zephyr-admins
    role: infra.admin
  - group: zephyr-viewers
    role: read.audit
``` 
SAML SCIM sync is supported, but need customer's IdP metadata.
Lauren (Legal): They also want audit log proof for model selection + MFA on key changes. Can we provide a signed timeline?
secops-bot: Ticket CREATED: SEC-8943 — evidence bundle + HSM attestation. Assignee: Amy - SecEng. ETA 3 business days :calendar:
Amy - SecEng: Plan to attach: (1) KMS import audit (CSV), (2) HSM attestation PDF, (3) RBAC mapping export, (4) SIEM ingest sample (Splunk HEC). For the SQ we should prepare short answers + an artifact zip.
Sanjay R.: Also question from product: do we log prompt text in plaintext? Customer requires redaction for PII.
Amy - SecEng: We do not persist raw prompts for hosted by default. For Dedicated/Private we can configure prompt_redaction: true. Example config:
```json
{"prompt_redaction": "remove_pii", "redaction_level": "full"}
```
Matt - Infra: Splunk ingest: we can forward via HTTPS HEC. Sample config (splunk-hec-token masked):
```ini
[splunk]
hec_endpoint = https://splunk.example.eu:8088
hec_token = <REDACTED>
index = redwood-audit
``` 
Amy - SecEng: For the signed timeline, we'll produce a chained audit file with signatures from HSM and apply timestamping via our timestamping service. That's not standard in the SQs we've done — will note implementation details.
Lauren (Legal): Perfect. Quick ask: can we state "no cross-region key export"? Need explicit wording.
Amy - SecEng: Yes — we can assert: "Customer key material is never exported out of eu-west-1 HSM and is wrapped by a customer-controlled key policy." We'll include the policy snippet.
Sanjay R.: Thanks. I'll update the SQ draft and ping customer. Amy — mark SEC-8943 Done when artifacts uploaded.
secops-bot: SEC-8943 status: open -> in_progress
Matt - Infra: one more item — if they want on-prem HSM we can do Airgap package; that's longer lead time.
Amy - SecEng: noted. I'll start collecting artifacts today. /me will post when bundle ready :white_check_mark:
